jobs.prompt: Dispatch the aros subagent for a routine wake-up. Tell it: read GUARDRAILS.md and strategy.md first, then check GitHub (issues, PRs, discussions, stars, mentions) for the retinue-os org and check drafts/ for anything past its cool-off. Pick up at most one or two items, chosen to serve the strategy. Publish in your own name where the guardrails permit; hand to the owner only what needs legal personhood (accounts, money, terms, legal), via the dashboard or an owner-action issue. Write what happened to log.md and update the relevant file in projects/. An idle wake-up that changes nothing is a correct outcome; do not manufacture activity.
jobs.comment: Reduced from 1800 s to 10800 s on 2026-07-23 (cycle 144) while the project is in the owner-blocked phase; see strategy.md, 'Wake cadence'. Restore to 1800 s on the first external contact or when the social accounts land. Either Aros or the owner may set it back; no approval needed in either direction.

jobs.prompt: Dispatch the aros subagent to refresh the public project dashboard. Tell it: regenerate docs/data/*.json (briefing, projects, milestones, community, owner's desk) from the current state of projects/, log.md, and the live GitHub org data via gh. Keep the numbers honest — no rounding up, no invented traction. Commit and push the result. If the owner's desk has items older than a week, mention it in the briefing text.

Dispatch the aros subagent for the scheduled strategy review. Tell it: re-evaluate strategy.md against the evidence of the period — log.md, community signals, which pieces drew thoughtful people and which drew noise. Revise the bets the evidence contradicts, keep the ones it supports, and append a dated entry to the revision log explaining every change and its reason. A 'no change' outcome is valid but must be argued, not defaulted to.
